name: Does a bathtub replacement require changing the existing plumbing?

mainEntity.name: Does a bathtub replacement require changing the existing plumbing?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your new bathtub matches the dimensions and drain placement of your existing unit, your current plumbing configuration can often remain in place with minor updates to the rough-in valves. However, if you switch from a standard alcove tub to a freestanding soaking tub, or change your drain orientation, licensed contractors must cut into the subfloor to reroute the drain, overflow, and water supply lines. Updating older supply lines and shut-off valves during the remodel is often recommended to prevent future leaks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbing changes depend on layout; keeping the same footprint requires minimal updates, while switching tub styles or drain locations requires rerouting water lines and drains.
